sn10.10:1.1: Ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe || 2.
sn10.10:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro upāsako Sukkāya bhikkhuniyā bhojanam adāsi || || 3.
sn10.10:1.3: Atha kho Sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho Rājagahe rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyam imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
